info.title: Mootz Meet interface
info.description: Implemented backend routes, pending product FE and actual deployment acceptance. Canonical typed-data/ABI come from sc/specs and sc/abi. Backend owns signatures, scopes, current bindings, time, foreground location, check-in and atomic limits. No precise coordinates enter onchain payloads. Unconfigured registry returns503 MEET_UNAVAILABLE.

post.description: Own published capture-source moment from the current WIB server day. Server returns pending session ID, immutable proof inputs, consent action and actual configured signing domain/types. Poster signs locally; unsigned sessions are not usable QR offers.

201.description: Unsigned session plus canonical domain/types/message and expiresAt

409.description: Ineligible moment or fresh consent required

put.description: Poster submits canonical65-byte signature. Backend verifies exact issued Offer and binding before making QR active; registration cannot extend signed issuedAt/expiresAt. QR contains only session ID plus exact signed Offer, domain and signature, not GPS/media/salt.

200.description: Active signed QR session, idempotent for identical signature

post.description: Scanner submits exact QR Offer and signature for backend validation and scoped preview. Must not grant friend access or expose other moments. Preview access ends at QR expiry. Only one scanner may finalize; preview itself never creates Meet/Dot.

200.description: moment.authorUsername (string|null poster @handle) is included. Scoped backend media POST paths and per-side SHA256, private salt proof, domain/types and acceptance template. Return image bytes only through the authenticated expiring media routes; never expose provider signed URLs.

409.description: QR already consumed or own scanner prohibited

put.description: Poster refreshes one foreground sample bound to the active signed session. Accept never trusts scanner-provided poster coordinates. Runtime must discard pending sample at session expiry/validation; no location-sharing history.

200.description: Fresh sample received without echoing coordinates

post.description: Scanner submits canonical Accept signature plus own sample. Server derives account/wallet, consumes exactly one QR, reserves pair+area+WIBday/maxfive and creates one offchain Dot for both participants atomically before relay. Matching retry returns same Meet. Exact-at-expiry fails. Both event check-ins and active event window are verified without modifying signed eventId.

200.description: Same valid Meet/Dot result on exact retry

post.description: Scanner sends bearer token plus the same offerDigest/posterSignature used for preview. Backend downloads private bytes and rechecks scope/expiry after storage returns. No provider signed URL is exposed. Use fetch then a local blob URL for display; do not turn this into a public image endpoint.

410.description: QR expired, including during storage read

get.description: Participant-authorized status separates valid offchain Meet/Dot from relay pending/recorded/not_saved. Onchain retry failure or opt-out never deletes Dot. Authoritative recorded status requires matching receipt/readback.

200.description: Meet/Dot plus separate onchain status and optional verified public transaction reference; no raw GPS or private keys

Signature.description: Strict low-s ECDSA, v27/28; not personal-sign or compact signatures

LocationSample.description: Foreground only. Age at authoritative acceptance must be in [-5000,15000] milliseconds; pair distance<=100m. Samples are private and excluded from QR/onchain/read responses.
